observation.command:
cd /workspace && source /etc/profile.d/rvm-fnm.sh 2>/dev/null
echo "== spring stop =="; bin/spring stop 2>&1 | head -1
echo "== try bundler 2.4.22 for bin/rspec --version =="
BUNDLER_VERSION=2.4.22 timeout 90 bin/rspec --version 2>&1 | head -4; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
echo "== bundle _2.4.22_ exec rspec --version =="
timeout 90 bundle _2.4.22_ exec rspec --version 2>&1 | head -4; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
